130	person's money, because HaShem knows.
131	And yirat Shamayim is not something meant to bring a person
132	into anxiety and pressure, but on the contrary, into great
133	joy. A person who lives with yirat Shamayim, that HaShem
134	fills the whole earth with His glory, always feels
135	that he is watched over. There is One who guards him.
136	Let us imagine
137	a ship, a ship of the American Navy.
138	They send it on some operation, a small ship like this,
139	with barely a few dozen soldiers. They send it
140	on the operation, it knows it could be bombed, and they
141	are careful,
142	living in fear of being hit. That same ship,
143	the commander of this ship is told: you will join
144	the ships that escort
145	the heaviest, most serious aircraft carrier
146	the United States has. They say it is now called
147	the Abraham Lincoln, after their president. A ship
148	that is something enormous,
149	like an entire city,
150	and they tell him: join the escort. There are several escort ships,
151	and you will be there too.
152	What feeling do the soldiers serving on
153	this small Navy ship have? Suddenly
154	the feeling changes.
155	Look what I have beside me. There is an aircraft carrier, it has
156	defense systems. It has missiles. If anyone only
157	dares to launch a missile, surely they will neutralize
158	it in the air and send it back.
159	Look who is beside me.
160	This example is pale compared to a person who feels
161	that HaShem is with him, is with him every
162	moment, every hour. This is what King David said: HaShem
163	is for me, I will not fear. What can man do to me? He says
164	HaShem is with me, so I will not fear. I am not afraid
165	of anyone. What can man do to me? What will he say?
166	But look, that one was hit. I trust in HaShem
167	that every course of events in my life is
168	for my good. What do I want, for it to be good for me? He
169	guards me, surely it will be good for me. When a person lives
170	this way, he is freed from anxieties, pressures, worries,
171	what will be in the future? Because he feels HaShem
172	is with me. And by the way, this is good advice for a person who begins
173	to feel anxiety or already suffers from anxiety. There is a certain matter
174	that stresses him, worry about the future: let him take
175	verses from the Book of Tehilim of King David, strong,
176	powerful verses, let him write them down for himself, and every few
177	days let him say this verse: this is my password now.
178	After a few days it already loses its effect because he
179	has gotten used to the words, but for a few days let him take this verse,
180	repeat it, be moved by it.
181	There is more in the famous psalm: HaShem is my shepherd, I shall not lack.
182	There are wonderful verses there of resilience, of strength, of
183	trust, when a person repeats them
184	and makes it real to himself that truly HaShem is for me, I will not fear.
185	HaShem is here, the whole earth is full of His glory. And whoever
186	trains himself to take the idea that Rabban Yochanan ben Zakai
187	told his students, "May the fear of Heaven be upon you
188	like the fear of flesh and blood," says to himself:
189	I relate to Divine Providence
190	no less than to people being around me.
191	When people are around, I do not do foolish things.
192	Even when I am alone I do not do foolish things, because
193	HaShem is here. Near people I would not
194	watch such films. Even when I am alone I do not
195	watch, because HaShem is here.
196	This yirat Shamayim leads a person to constant
197	joy in life. Because once he is convinced that I do not
198	do foolish things because HaShem is here, he is also
199	convinced that HaShem guards and watches over him
200	every single moment. And in the Gemara it is written
201	on the verse "Sinners in Zion are afraid"
202	that when a person sins, it brings anxieties, pressures
203	and fears into him. Not necessarily only from sins, but a person
204	who knows that the truth is here and I am going there, I keep
205	repeating the same mistake. Something that is not right.
206	It is a sin and I do it again. It
207	brings a person into sadness, because the soul feels I am
208	not on the right path. If he knows he is going
209	on the right path with HaShem, but there are
210	stumbles, then fine. "A righteous man falls seven times and rises." A person
211	falls, gets up,
212	it always hurts him, after every fall he wants to correct
213	himself. Each one on his own personal path. For
214	one it is in matters of holiness. For another, keeping
215	Shabbat. For another, lashon hara and gossip. Each
216	one with the trials he has, with the difficulty he
217	struggles with. But he knows, the path I am walking
218	is the right path. It is the way of HaShem. I am not
219	an angel, so I have falls too, but I immediately
220	check how to fix it. For such a person, the fears
221	depart from him, because he feels that HaShem watches
222	over him, guards him: HaShem is for me, I will not fear, what can man
223	do to me?
